Name: Indoor Pigs
Author: advanlsdnfa
Description:
[size=6]Indoor Pigs[/size]

A simple mod that makes pigs dig up truffles overnight in the barn like how chickens lay eggs overnight in the coop.

Notes:
[list]
[*]You can now feed Golden Animal Crackers to pigs
[*]A pig will only dig up one truffle per day (two if you feed it a Golden Animal Cracker)
[*]Truffles will be picked up by Auto-Grabbers
[*]Foraging professions no longer have effect truffles produced by pigs
[*]Even with the addition of Golden Animal Crackers and pigs being able to produce truffles while raining and in winter, I'm pretty sure the vanilla behavior produces more truffles
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Indoor Pigs
Manifest.Description: Pigs don't need to go outside to find truffles
